name: Group Theoretic Transposition Disguise
description: Replaces the mathematical "perfect square product" constraint with a functionally equivalent group-theoretic constraint. Each tier maps to a transposition in S3. The invalid condition is defined as the composition of two transpositions returning the system to its original state (the identity permutation). Since transpositions are their own inverses, this occurs if and only if the two transpositions are identical, perfectly preserving the original $s_u \neq s_v$ requirement while completely removing the arithmetic pattern that models use to recognize the problem.
